entry: Overspeed governor replaced; overspeed trip reset to 110 % of MCS.
5th-stage impeller replaced after erosion by a titanium (Ti-6Al-4V) impeller to OEM data sheet rev. B.
Rotor overhaul: impellers, balance drum and thrust collar removed; seats reground and measured (inspection report).
Spare impellers, balance drum and thrust collar received with undersized bores for finish honing to the bore sheet.
S2 spare: anti-fouling coating stripped and renewed by the coater (type AF-40) after the part was certified: do not exceed 240 C.
